goal: 完成用户首测截图和长录音反馈修复

source.approval_evidence: User current feedback and standing explicit implement/audit/test/commit/local delivery authorization

requirements.statement: 暖截图快速且图像绘制就绪再展示
画笔文字撤销完成取消并复制真实标注PNG
识图禁用原因可见且当前正确多模态配置可跑通
长录音首中尾采集完整并排空停止尾帧
连续WAV分段有界请求且拒绝不完整输出
失败保留可恢复数据不将部分结果当完整交付

acceptance.check: warm/cold latency metadata and ready handshake runtime
annotation pixel behavior and native pen/text/confirm/cancel
missing config reason then explicit enable screenshot-to-recognition
3/5 minute sample coverage, background and tail flush
sample byte reconstruction, request max duration and failure paths
failure/recovery/retry never publishes partial or automatically pastes recovered text
relevant original unit and production Electron regression

dependencies.statement: current MM false and per-capture process startup

assumptions.statement: 30-second prefix may involve capture or service truncation
assumptions.validation: inspect collection plus real/fixture request finish reasons and duration; no sole-cause claim without evidence

invariants: retain prior hotkeys/model declarations/clipboard-only vision/voice-text-undo guards
clean Luna reviewer only writes audit; no implementation edits during review
no secret or user image/audio bytes in Git

implementation_units.objective: long audio capture chunk and recovery

validation_boundaries.trigger: shared capture/model/state interface and complete user feedback acceptance

provider_policy.data: frozen synthetic only; old8 unchanged; no user desktop/audio
provider_policy.gate: freeze corpus/request hashes and counters before decoding configured active key; no calls on gate failure
provider_policy.retries: no automatic whole-task retry or budget reset

final_acceptance.release_boundary: parent final check and clean Luna audit then authorized local main promotion/portable only
